objective: Implement deterministic provider-scoped funding, open-interest and liquidation observations plus a non-prescriptive crowding evidence vector without inventing an unvalidated trading score.
scope: Define governed derivatives observation policy and metric taxonomy
Implement funding-rate observations with explicit funding interval semantics
Implement open-interest observations with explicit provider-defined unit
Implement long/short liquidation observations with explicit matching liquidation unit
Require provider, venue, instrument, coverage scope, point-in-time fields and trusted provenance
Build same-stream crowding evidence vector requiring one observation of each governed metric kind
Compute deterministic liquidation total and long-vs-short liquidation imbalance basis points
Represent zero-liquidation imbalance as unavailable rather than directional zero evidence
out_of_scope: Arbitrary crowding score or crowded/uncrowded classification before P09-H validation
Synthetic spot-FX funding, OI or liquidation metrics
Signal fusion, calibrated trade probability, Risk approval or broker/exchange execution
dependencies: Fresh Live Guard: open PRs 0, active task none, active lock none
tests: Strict Pyright passes for P09 derivatives/crowding source
Funding observation requires positive interval and DECIMAL_RATE unit
OI and liquidation observations reject negative values and funding interval metadata
Spot FX derivatives metrics fail closed
Crowding evidence requires exactly one Funding/OI/Long Liquidation/Short Liquidation observation
Crowding observations must share symbol, market class, provider, venue, coverage scope and as-of time
Liquidation imbalance is deterministic and bounded to [-10000,10000] bps
Zero liquidation activity produces unavailable imbalance rather than directional evidence
Crowding identity is deterministic and content-sensitive
P09-F evidence is byte-identical across two runs
security_tests: No broker/exchange execution adapter is imported
No credential or network access is required
No cross-provider/global derivatives aggregation is synthesized
rollback: Revert P09-F derivatives/crowding module, policy, tests, evidence/CI wiring and active-state reconciliation. P09-A/B/C/D/E remain canonical and no production/trading state changes.
definition_of_done: Funding/OI/liquidation and crowding evidence contracts implemented
Point-in-time, same-stream, unit and provenance invariants enforced
No unvalidated crowding score or trading authority introduced
Deterministic evidence and strict CI pass
Post-merge Governance and Branch Hygiene pass
